title: 直升機尾旋翼安全工程
summary: 以「以反扭矩、力臂和可見性理解尾旋翼安全概念」為主線，在非飛行旋翼力矩與地面場景模型中依序完成主軸功率與反扭矩、旋轉幾何與槳尖速度、地面標示與視野、地面監視資料的延遲、警示可信度與漏報及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Understand tail-rotor safety through reaction torque, moment arm and visibility in a Non-flying rotor-torque and ground-scene model, progressing through Main-shaft power and reaction torque, Rotation geometry and tip speed, Ground signs and field of view, Ground-monitoring data latency, Warning credibility and misses, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 主軸功率與反扭矩：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Main-shaft power and reaction torque: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 主軸功率與反扭矩 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Main-shaft power and reaction torque and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「直升機尾旋翼安全工程」中，本單元處理「主軸功率與反扭矩」。主軸功率除角速度得到反扭矩；反作用力矩需由其他載荷路徑平衡。
steps.instructionEn: Within Helicopter tail-rotor safety engineering, this unit examines Main-shaft power and reaction torque. Shaft power divided by angular speed gives reaction torque, which another load path must balance.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：軸功率 P=2000 W、角速度ω=100 rad/s。關係式 Q=P/ω；含輸出單位換算的算式 2000/100，結果 20 N m。適用範圍：定功率理想軸系，非旋翼機操作或軍用性能計算。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Shaft power P=2000 W and angular speed omega=100 rad/s. Relation Q=P/ω; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 2000/100 gives 20 N m. Applicability: Ideal constant-power shaft; not rotorcraft operating guidance or military performance calculation.
steps.failure: 在「主軸功率與反扭矩」的情境中，只畫升力而漏掉反扭矩，會使機體力矩收支不閉合。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Main-shaft power and reaction torque, A lift-only diagram omits reaction torque and leaves moments unbalanced.
steps.check: 針對「主軸功率與反扭矩」，在非飛行示意模型上標主軸與機身的相反力矩方向。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Main-shaft power and reaction torque, Mark opposing shaft/body torques on a non-flying schematic. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 ω 改為80 rad/s，其餘條件固定。用 2000/80 重算，結果從 20 變成 25 N m。先預測方向，再記下對「主軸功率與反扭矩」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only omega to 80 rad/s, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 2000/80: 20 becomes 25 N m. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Main-shaft power and reaction torque, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「直升機尾旋翼安全工程」的「主軸功率與反扭矩：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Main-shaft power and reaction torque: Mechanism and observation” in “Helicopter tail-rotor safety engineering”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
